why: shorter; dashes removed; defines minerals
old: Producers can't make food from sunlight alone — they need four key inputs: sunlight (energy), water (pulled up through roots), carbon dioxide from the air (absorbed through tiny pores in their leaves), and minerals from the soil (like nitrogen and phosphorus that help them grow). Take away any one of these and the plant can't produce food — which means the entire food chain above it would collapse!
new: Producers need four things: sunlight (the energy), water (pulled up through their roots), carbon dioxide from the air (taken in through tiny holes in their leaves), and minerals from the soil (nutrients like nitrogen that help them grow). Take away any one, and the plant can’t make enough food. Then every animal that depends on it goes hungry.
